primer: Strategy Inc combines a cash-negative analytics software unit with 850,849 Bitcoin funded by $6.75 billion in convertible debt and $13.48 billion in adjusted preferred liquidation preference. On November 20, 2026, MSTR closed at $77.80 alongside $58,798.98 Bitcoin, breaching the prior $79.00 structural stop in a Stage 4 markdown with 20.22 daily RSI. At 0.972x EV-to-Bitcoin mNAV, the accretive equity-issuance flywheel is broken, leaving 12-month Base fair value at $76.34 and probability-weighted value at $66.86 per share. With zero shares held in the portfolio ledger, we assign REJECTED and NOT_HELD while keeping 100% of marginal capital in cash.
